name: Shanghai Shine-Link International Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Shine-Link International Logistics Co., Ltd. provides a wide range of logistics solutions to a global clientele, including numerous Fortune 500 corporations. Their comprehensive services encompass unified online and offline warehousing, consignment repair management, e-commerce platform administration with specialized peak season solutions, and global freight forwarding, including tailored transportation for unique items. The company also offers import and export trade solutions for special vehicles, as well as dedicated logistics for consumer products, online ingredients, and admission processes. Shine-Link serves diverse industries such as information electronics, automotive manufacturing, medical equipment and consumables, heavy machinery, consumer goods and e-commerce, aerospace manufacturing and materials management, and specialized handling for artwork and critical documents/vouchers. Established in 2001, the firm is based in Shanghai, China.
